privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: Transparency about personal data processing, in compliance with Brazil's General Data Protection Law (LGPD — Law No. 13,709/2018).

sections.heading: 1. Who we are
paragraphs: This Privacy Policy describes how {controller_name} ("Controller", "we") processes personal data on {site_name}, available at {site_url}.
For privacy questions or to exercise your rights, contact us at {controller_email}.

sections.heading: 2. What data we collect
paragraphs: We collect only the data necessary to operate this professional portfolio website:
list: Browsing data: IP address, browser type, pages visited, date and time of access, and preferred language (when applicable).
Language preference: stored locally in your browser (localStorage) to remember PT, EN, or ES.
Chat messages: text you send to the virtual assistant, only if you use the chat feature.
Contact data: when you email us or message through external channels (LinkedIn, email), we process the information you voluntarily share.

sections.heading: 3. Purpose and legal bases
paragraphs: We use data for the following purposes, based on legal grounds under the LGPD:
list: Display the portfolio and enable site navigation (contract performance or preliminary procedures / legitimate interest).
Remember your language preference (consent, via local storage).
Answer questions in the AI-assisted chat about professional experience (consent and legitimate interest).
Contact you when you request opportunities or information (contract performance or consent).
Ensure security, prevent fraud, and improve the site experience (legitimate interest).

sections.heading: 4. Cookies and similar technologies
paragraphs: This site uses localStorage to save the selected language. We do not use third-party advertising tracking cookies.
You can clear stored browser data at any time in your device settings.

sections.heading: 5. Data sharing
paragraphs: We do not sell or rent personal data. Sharing occurs only when necessary:
list: Infrastructure providers (GitHub Pages) for site hosting.
Automation/AI services (when configured) to process chat messages, always with appropriate security measures.
Competent authorities when required by law or court order.

sections.heading: 6. Data retention
paragraphs: We retain data for as long as necessary to fulfill the purposes described in this Policy or as required by law.
Chat messages may be discarded periodically. Language preferences remain on your device until you remove them.
Email communications are kept as long as needed to respond to requests and meet legal obligations.

sections.heading: 7. Your rights (data subject)
paragraphs: Under the LGPD, you may request at any time:
list: Confirmation of processing and access to your data.
Correction of incomplete, inaccurate, or outdated data.
Anonymization, blocking, or deletion of unnecessary or unlawfully processed data.
Data portability to another provider, when applicable.
Deletion of data processed based on consent.
Information about sharing and the possibility of withholding consent.
Revocation of consent when processing is based on consent.
paragraphs_after: To exercise your rights, send a request to {controller_email}. We will respond within legal timeframes.
You may also file a complaint with Brazil's National Data Protection Authority (ANPD): https://www.gov.br/anpd/

sections.heading: 8. Security
paragraphs: We adopt reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect data against unauthorized access, loss, or improper alteration.
No system is 100% secure; we recommend not sharing sensitive or confidential information via chat or public forms.

sections.heading: 9. International transfer
paragraphs: Some service providers (such as GitHub) may process data on servers outside Brazil. In such cases, we seek to ensure an adequate level of protection under the LGPD.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to this Policy
paragraphs: We may update this Policy periodically. The date of the last revision will be shown at the top of the page.
We recommend revisiting this page regularly to stay informed.

terms.title: Terms of Use
terms.subtitle: Conditions for using this professional portfolio website.

sections.heading: 1. Acceptance
paragraphs: By accessing and using {site_url}, you agree to these Terms of Use and our Privacy Policy.
If you do not agree, please stop using the site.

sections.heading: 2. Purpose of the site
paragraphs: This site presents professional information, projects, experience, and contact options for {controller_name}.
Content is informational and does not constitute a binding commercial offer unless expressly agreed otherwise.

sections.heading: 3. Permitted use
paragraphs: You may browse, view information, and contact us through the channels provided.
You may not use the site for unlawful purposes, send offensive content, attempt to breach systems, perform abusive scraping, or interfere with service operation.

sections.heading: 4. Intellectual property
paragraphs: Texts, layout, visual identity, described projects, and other materials belong to {controller_name} or their respective owners, protected by applicable law.
Reproduction, distribution, or modification without prior authorization is prohibited, except when permitted by law.

sections.heading: 5. Virtual assistant chat (AI)
paragraphs: The site chat uses automated responses based on portfolio information. Answers may contain inaccuracies and do not replace direct communication or formal hiring.
Do not send sensitive data (health, financial, personal documents) via chat.
Using the chat implies consent to process messages as described in the Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 6. External links
paragraphs: The site may contain links to LinkedIn, GitHub, resume, and other third-party services. We are not responsible for the content or privacy practices of those sites.

sections.heading: 7. Limitation of liability
paragraphs: The site is provided "as is." We make reasonable efforts to keep information up to date but do not guarantee uninterrupted availability or complete absence of errors.
To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect damages arising from use or inability to use the site.

sections.heading: 8. Privacy and personal data
paragraphs: Personal data processing is governed by the Privacy Policy, which is an integral part of these Terms.

sections.heading: 9. Changes
paragraphs: We may change these Terms at any time. Relevant changes will be published on this page with a new update date.
Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance of the new Terms.

sections.heading: 10. Applicable law and jurisdiction
paragraphs: These Terms are governed by the laws of the Federative Republic of Brazil.
The courts of the user's domicile in Brazil are chosen to resolve disputes, unless otherwise required by law.

sections.heading: 11. Contact
paragraphs: Questions about these Terms: {controller_email}.
